description_en: Enables or disables auto-renewal for a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance
description_zh: 开启或者关闭云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的到期前自动续费功能
name: ModifyInstanceAutoRenewalAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance. Separate multiple instance IDs with commas (,).

You can specify up to 30 instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。多个实例ID用英文逗号（,）分隔。
最多允许传入30个实例ID。
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal period. Valid values: 1 to 12. Unit: months. When the instance is about to expire, the instance is automatically renewed based on the number of months specified by this parameter.

This parameter is available and required only if the AutoRenew parameter is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
自动续费周期，取值范围为1~12，单位为月。实例即将到期时，系统将自动地以选择的续费时长进行续费。
当AutoRenew参数取值为true时，本参数才可用且必须传入
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

true
false

The default value is false
parameters.help_zh:
开启或关闭自动续费，取值：
true：开启。
false。关闭。

默认值：false
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en: The service. Set the value to kvstore
parameters.name: product
